quizzes.question_text:
Morgan has $500 and wants to deposit the money into a savings account for one year.
Starlight Bank pays $4 interest each year for every $100 in a savings account.
Moonbeam Bank pays $5 interest each year for every $100 in a savings account.
Moonbeam Bank charges a $10 yearly fee on savings accounts.
Which bank has the better savings option for Morgan?
quizzes.question_type: Multiple Choice Question with Single Answer
solution: Find which savings option gives Morgan more money after one year.
Find how much money Morgan will have with Starlight Bank.
Starlight Bank pays $4 interest for every hundred dollars in a savings account. Morgan has 5 hundred dollars.

Multiply $4 by 5.
$4 \times 5 = $20
Starlight Bank will pay Morgan $20 interest.

Add $20 interest to the $500 Morgan has to start.
$500 + $20 = $516
Morgan will have $516 after one year if they keep their money at Starlight Bank.
Find how much money Morgan will have with Moonbeam Bank.
Moonbeam Bank pays $5 interest for every hundred dollars in a savings account. Morgan has 5 hundred dollars.

Multiply $5 by 5.
$5 \times 5 = $25
Moonbeam Bank will pay Morgan $25 interest.

Add $25 interest to the $500 Morgan has to start.
$500 + $25 = $525

Now, subtract the $10 yearly fee that Moonbeam Bank charges.
$525 - $10 = $515
Morgan will have $515 after one year if they keep their money at Moonbeam Bank.
Since $516 is more than $515, Starlight Bank has the better savings option for Morgan.

Olivia wants to buy a Lightning Strike Nintendo Switch, but needs $380. They think of two plans to save this money.
Plan A: Save $17 each week for 22 weeks. Put the money in a savings account that will pay a total of $2 in interest.

Which plan should Olivia follow to save enough money to buy the Nintendo Switch?
quizzes.question_type: Multiple Choice Question with Single Answer
solution: Olivia needs $380 to buy the Nintendo Switch. Find which plan will save enough money.

Find how much money Olivia will save with Plan A.
Plan A is to save $17 each week for 22 weeks and earn $2 in interest.

First, multiply $17 by 22.
$17 \times 22 = $374

Then, add $2 interest.
$374 + $2 = $376
Olivia will save $376 with Plan A. That is not enough money to buy the Nintendo Switch.

Find how much money Olivia will save with Plan B.
Plan B is to save $13 each week for 24 weeks and earn $6 in interest.

First, multiply $13 by 24.
$13 \times 24 = $312

Then, add $6 interest.
$312 + $6 = $318
Olivia will save $318 with Plan B. That is not enough money to buy the Nintendo Switch.
Olivia should follow Plan B.

quizzes.question_text:
Morgan has $500 and wants to deposit the money into a savings account for one year.
Starlight Bank pays $4 interest each year for every $100 in a savings account.
Moonbeam Bank pays $5 interest each year for every $100 in a savings account.
Moonbeam Bank charges a $10 yearly fee on savings accounts.
Which bank has the better savings option for Morgan?
quizzes.question_type: Multiple Choice Question with Single Answer
solution: Find which savings option gives Morgan more money after one year.
Find how much money Morgan will have with Starlight Bank.
Starlight Bank pays $4 interest for every hundred dollars in a savings account. Morgan has 5 hundred dollars.

Multiply $4 by 5.
$4 \times 5 = $20
Starlight Bank will pay Morgan $20 interest.

Add $20 interest to the $500 Morgan has to start.
$500 + $20 = $516
Morgan will have $516 after one year if they keep their money at Starlight Bank.
Find how much money Morgan will have with Moonbeam Bank.
Moonbeam Bank pays $5 interest for every hundred dollars in a savings account. Morgan has 5 hundred dollars.

Multiply $5 by 5.
$5 \times 5 = $25
Moonbeam Bank will pay Morgan $25 interest.

Add $25 interest to the $500 Morgan has to start.
$500 + $25 = $525

Now, subtract the $10 yearly fee that Moonbeam Bank charges.
$525 - $10 = $515
Morgan will have $515 after one year if they keep their money at Moonbeam Bank.
Since $516 is more than $515, Starlight Bank has the better savings option for Morgan.
